# form.addTimeField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Add a time field to the current form.

```lua
form.addTimeField(line, rect, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current time |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on time change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addTimeField(line, nil, function() return time end, function(newValue) time = newValue end)
```
